description_expanded: Description Description 30A ESCAPES presents…Beachfront Bliss On 30A! Wake up to 180-degree Gulf views in this newly renovated 3rd-floor Gulf-front corner condo at the exclusive Monterey complex in Seacrest West. With updated interiors, 3 suites for up to 7 guests and steps from the beach, it offers ultimate comfort. Enjoy a private Gulf-front pool and 4 beach bikes to explore 30A’s charming towns of Rosemary and Alys Beach. Learn more below…*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Gulf-front Corner Unit with Panoramic Views - Experience breathtaking, uninterrupted views of the Gulf from this stunning corner unit—pure coastal bliss at every glance.Newly Renovated - This beautifully updated unit now accommodates up to 7 guests with fresh, stylish furnishings: 2 King suites and a Queen guest bedroom with a Twin bedSpacious Extended Balcony - Unwind or host on this oversized balcony, where the sea breeze and sunsets set the perfect mood for any occasion.Seasonal Beach Chair Setup Included (March through September) - Relax in style with included beach chairs, ensuring a stress-free and comfortable day by the shore during the sunny seasons.Fully-equipped Kitchen - Cook and dine in style with a thoughtfully designed kitchen that captures the essence of coastal luxury.Gulf-front Community Pool - Dive into relaxation at the poolside, surrounded by Gulf views, while soaking up the sun in comfort.4 Bikes Included - Discover the charm of 30A on two wheels, riding through serene coastal trails and picturesque bike-friendly beach towns.Gulf-front Gated Community with Elevator Access - Enjoy peace of mind in a private, gated community with convenient elevator access for easy living.Eager to Read More?Here Are a Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ “Beautiful, modern condo with breathtaking views. A true gem on 30A!” – Mark B.⭐ “We’ve stayed here for years! Perfect location for families. Loved the beach access and nearby bike paths!” – Kristina W.⭐ “Amazing location with incredible views, clean and upscale! We will definitely return!” – Robert M.*** BEACHSIDE PARADISE ***Welcome to your dream getaway! This Gulf-front unit, located on the third floor of the exclusive Monterey Condominium Complex, offers unparalleled views of the sparkling Emerald Waters and stunning sunsets. With only 24 luxurious units directly on the beach, this serene retreat provides the perfect blend of privacy and elegance.*** LIVING AREA ***Step into a light-filled living space with stunning Gulf views. The open layout features plush seating and bright coastal accents, creating the perfect spot to unwind or entertain. Glass doors open to an oversized balcony where you can relax to the sound of waves.Gulf views from the living room through abundant large windowsComfortable seating with smart TV for relaxing or hostingDirect access to the extended Gulf-front balcony*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The sleek, fully-equipped kitchen has everything you need for a gourmet meal or seaside snack. Gather around the dining table or enjoy casual meals at the breakfast bar, all with Gulf views as your backdrop.Modern kitchen with full appliances and ample counter spaceDining table with seating for 6Breakfast bar with additional seating for 3*** OUTDOOR OASIS ***Take in the beauty of the Emerald Coast from your expansive corner balcony. Relax on the lounge chairs as the sun sets, or head down to the private Gulf-front pool just steps away.Private extended balcony with stunning Gulf viewsGulf-front pool with lounge chairs for ultimate relaxationEasy beach access just steps away*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Primary King Suite: 1 King Bed, smart TV, balcony access, and en-suite featuring a walk-in shower and double vanity.King Guest Suite: 1 King Bed, smart TV, and en-suite featuring shower/tub combo.Queen Guest Suite: 1 Queen Bed with 1 Twin Bed, and en-suite featuring shower/tub combo.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Nestled along the stunning Scenic Highway 30A, between Rosemary Beach and Seagrove Beach, this condo immerses you in the heart of Seacrest West charm. Just moments away, you'll find the captivating communities of Rosemary Beach, Seagrove Beach, Alys Beach, Watercolor, and Watersound, each offering its own unique coastal allure.Convenience is at your fingertips with nearby grocery stores and exceptional dining options only a short drive away. Take advantage of the 4 bikes provided to explore the breathtaking coastline and soak up the laid-back coastal vibes. Your ultimate beachside escape awaits!Local shops and restaurants within minutes: Explore unique boutiques and savor fresh coastal cuisine without going far.Alys Beach – 4-min drive: A tranquil escape with iconic white architecture and a serene, upscale atmosphere.Rosemary Beach – 5-min drive: A European-inspired village with cobblestone streets, boutique shopping, and laid-back beach vibes.The Big Chill entertainment hub – 3-min drive: Enjoy outdoor movie nights, games, food trucks, and a fun, carefree atmosphere for all ages.Shop and dine along Hwy 30A or beyond: Browse unique shops and enjoy coastal dining along 30A or venture out to Silver Sands Outlet Mall, Destin Commons, Pier Park, or Panama City—all just minutes away.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.This property has 1 included beach set-up available 3/1 to 10/1, featuring 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella.The community pool is only heated from October 1 to December 1.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 207710 Read less
